city.description: City name to search for rentals (e.g. 'Phoenix', 'New York'). Required unless `startUrls` is provided.
city.title: City

includeReviews.description: Try to extract individual review text, ratings, and dates when FurnishedFinder embeds them in the property page. Note: only a small fraction of FurnishedFinder properties expose reviews in the page payload — most only expose `avgRating` and `totalReviewCount`. The rating/count fields are extracted regardless of this toggle when present.
includeReviews.title: Include Reviews

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to scrape
maxItems.title: Max Items

moreDetails.description: Extract landlord name, biography, profile image, verification status, and nearby hospitals from the property page.
moreDetails.title: Fetch Landlord Details

moveInDate.description: Target move-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format
moveInDate.title: Move-in Date

propertyType.description: Filter by property type. FurnishedFinder only exposes two filter classes: 'room' (private room in a shared place) and 'entire_unit' (whole apartment/house/condo). The granular type (House, Condo, Apartment) appears in the output `propertyType` field of every record.
propertyType.title: Property Type

proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy configuration. Apify Proxy (datacenter) is enabled by default — FurnishedFinder uses Cloudflare which blocks plain datacenter requests without proxy rotation.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

startUrls.description: Override city/state with explicit FurnishedFinder URLs — search pages or /property/{id}_{unit} URLs. When set, city and state are ignored.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (optional)

state.description: US state — full name (e.g. 'Arizona') or two-letter code (e.g. 'AZ'). Required unless `startUrls` is provided.
state.title: State
